input: Sell old furniture on a local marketplace app

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many pieces and what types of furniture are involved changes the complexity of listing, pricing research, and logistics significantly.
Whether this is for the user alone or involves coordinating with others (e.g., a household partner or a landlord) affects decision-making authority and scheduling.
The specific app or platform (e.g., Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp) determines the listing process, audience, and best practices to follow.
A hard deadline (e.g., moving date) or a minimum acceptable price changes how aggressively to price and how quickly to negotiate or re-list.
Whether the user prioritises speed of sale vs. maximum price changes the recommended pricing strategy and willingness to negotiate.
Knowing whether the user will offer delivery, require buyer pickup, or need help moving items out determines what information to include in listings and how to coordinate handoffs.
Understanding what a successful outcome looks like — e.g., all items sold, a specific amount of money made, or simply clearing space — shapes how to prioritise and measure progress.

gold.taskTitle: Sell old furniture on a local marketplace app
gold.taskDescription: List and sell pieces of old furniture using a local marketplace app, from preparing the items to completing the sale.

questions.title: How many furniture pieces are you looking to sell?
questions.description: Establish the total number and types of furniture items (e.g., one sofa, a full bedroom set) to scope the effort required for listing and coordination.

questions.title: Which marketplace app do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identify the specific platform (e.g., Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist) to tailor the listing steps, photo requirements, and messaging etiquette.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which items must be gone?
questions.description: Determine if there is a hard time constraint such as a move-out date or lease end that requires faster pricing and turnover decisions.

questions.title: Do you prioritise selling fast or getting the best price?
questions.description: Clarify whether speed or maximum return is the primary goal, as this drives the recommended pricing strategy and negotiation approach.

questions.title: Will buyers pick up, or will you offer delivery?
questions.description: Establish the handoff logistics to know what to state in listings, how to screen buyers, and whether transport help is needed.

questions.title: Is anyone else involved in this selling process?
questions.description: Find out if a partner, roommate, or family member shares ownership or needs to be consulted, which affects scheduling viewings and agreeing on prices.

questions.title: What does a successful sale look like to you?
questions.description: Understand the user's definition of done — whether it is all items sold, a target dollar amount earned, or simply clearing physical space — to set measurable goals.
